;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2018 As-Suwayda attacks]]
***Coordinated suicide bombings and shootings carried out by the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] in [[As-Suwayda]], [[Syria]], kill 215 people and injure more than 200 others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-attack/islamic-state-kills-dozens-in-south-syria-attacks-state-media-idUSKBN1KF0DG (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Quetta suicide bombing]]
**A blast outside a [[Polling place|polling station]] in [[Quetta]], [[Pakistan]], kills 31 people and wounds several more on election day. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-elections-23-killed-in-blast-in-quetta-say-reports/story-tD55pRKM9ww0ITdDOTh4oK.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

;Business and economy
*[[United States–European Union relations]], [[First Trump tariffs|Trump tariffs]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and European leaders agree to halt their trade war over vehicles and say they will open talks on removing trade barriers between the [[United States]] and the [[European Union]]. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/gop-lawmakers-critical-relief-program-farmers-052430924--finance.html (AP via Yahoo! Finance)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Attica wildfires]]
**The death toll from the wildfires in [[Greece]] rises to 80 people while many others are still missing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44948173 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Laos dam collapse]]
**The death toll from a dam collapse in [[Laos]] that caused heavy floods rises to 26, while more than 130 remain missing. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/laos-dam-disaster-17-bodies-flood-10561186 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*A [[Legionella]] outbreak in [[Bresso]], [[Italy]], kills three people while 17 others are hospitalized. [https://milano.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/18_luglio_25/bresso-salgono-17-casi-legionella-un-altra-anziana-morta-fe2bc5ec-8f7c-11e8-84b6-8543850c3d94.shtml (''Corriere Della Sera'')]
*[[Paraguay]]'s Minister of Agriculture, [[Luis Gneiting]], and three others are killed in a plane crash near [[Ayolas, Paraguay|Ayolas]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-paraguay-airplane/paraguay-agriculture-minister-among-four-dead-in-plane-crash-official-idUSKBN1KG1MV (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman]]
**Caitlan Coleman, the wife of former [[Taliban]] hostage Joshua Boyle, returns to the [[United States]] with her children after a family law court in [[Ottawa]] approved her request. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/mobile/canada/former-afghanistan-hostage-caitlan-coleman-leaves-canada-returns-to-u-s-with-kids-1.4026791#_gus&_gucid=&_gup=twitter&_gsc=iV4iX9h (CTV News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Pakistani general election, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Pakistan]] go to the polls to elect the members of the [[National Assembly of Pakistan|National Assembly]] and the four Provincial Assemblies of Pakistan. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-election-election/voting-begins-in-pakistans-general-election-idUSKBN1KF08C (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[Water on Mars]]
**Scientists at [[INAF]] announce the discovery of a liquid water lake beneath a [[Martian polar ice caps|polar ice cap]] on [[Mars]]. The discovery was made using [[MARSIS]], a radar instrument on board the [[European Space Agency]]'s ''[[Mars Express]]'' orbiter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-44952710 (BBC)]
